source: Static inspection of installed official version assemblies using ILSpy11.1.0.9782
authenticationPolicy: Keep VerifyPlayerAuth=true; use authorized accounts and a private test server. No licensing or authentication bypass.

targets.observed: Updates StatsCollector[StatsCollectorIndex] before deliberate Thread.Sleep. tickTimes is a 10-element circular array of elapsed integer milliseconds.
targets.caveats: Prefix/postfix wall time includes sleep; read newly written stock sample only. Suspended and standby calls return without writing a processing sample.

targets.observed: Drains main-thread tasks and ClientPackets, optionally parses packets in reduced-thread mode, then updates timers.
targets.caveats: Inclusive total overlaps packet handlers and callbacks. Do not report as pure network time.

targets.thread: packet-parser or main in reduced-thread mode
targets.observed: Deserializes Packet_Client and enqueues ReceivedClientPacket.
targets.caveats: Do not retain payloads, player identifiers or client references; preserve exception handling and anti-cheat ingress visibility.

targets.observed: Dispatches connection state changes and registered packet handlers.
targets.caveats: Inclusive handler duration; maintain order and packet validation.

targets.observed: Performs player selection ray tracing, TickEntities and death notifications.
targets.caveats: Cannot attribute entire method to AI; contains gameplay and network-related work.

targets.observed: Allocates a despawn List<KeyValuePair<Entity,EntityDespawnData>> and ticks all loaded entities except Dimensions.ShouldNotTick.
targets.caveats: Changing activation intervals changes simulation. Temp-list reuse must preserve original iteration, per-entity catches, despawn timing, reentrancy, and finally cleanup.

targets.observed: Optionally shuffles tasks, starts eligible tasks, processes running tasks and logs debug state.
targets.caveats: Skipping the manager delays attack, escape, damage responses and modded task hooks; no blanket distance throttling justified.

targets.observed: Calls ShouldExecute for priority/slot-eligible tasks before event gating.
targets.caveats: Timing totals include ShouldExecute, task start/stop and event handlers; tasks may depend on order and RNG.

targets.observed: Processes active task CanContinueExecute and ContinueExecute.
targets.caveats: Must remain responsive for combat and movement; do not change dt or suppress calls.

targets.observed: When queue count exceeds 1, main thread processes overflow with a nominal 1000-task cap.
targets.caveats: Queue is concurrently consumed by dedicated worker; Count is approximate diagnostic. Static loop-cap ordering concern requires focused reproduction before repair.

targets.observed: Dequeue/find path/mark Finished loop; worker invokes with maxCount=100.
targets.caveats: Do not share AStar state across threads or drop queued tasks. Static loop-cap ordering concern requires focused reproduction.

targets.observed: Enqueues a PathfinderTask into public ConcurrentQueue<PathfinderTask>.
targets.caveats: Queue latency tracking must be bounded and remove completed entries; neither task objects nor failed tasks may be retained indefinitely.

targets.observed: Skips inactive/non-interactable/non-movable/mounted entities and initial 2 seconds; scans partitioned creature neighbors and applies motion.
targets.caveats: Respects dimensions and custom ICustomRepulseBehavior. Pairwise arithmetic and traversal order affect physics; no blanket downsampling justified.

targets.observed: Registered every32ms; clears partitions and creates EntityPartitionChunk instances while assigning players entityListForPartitioning.
targets.caveats: Exposed Partitions and player retained list references complicate reuse and invalidation; no simplistic clear-and-pool patch.

targets.observed: Clears per-tick chunk-packet caches, collects mini-dimension data, iterates connected/playing clients.
targets.caveats: Existing packet reuse lasts one tick and differs for with/without entities. OreShield may require per-player filtered content; do not broaden cache lifetime or sharing.

targets.observed: Caps radius using Config.MaxChunkRadius and per-client view distance, uses MagicNum.ChunksToSendPerTick, handles forced chunks/mapchunks.
targets.caveats: Critical force sends and entity payloads require ordering; batching/deduplication must preserve per-player visibility and server-authoritative changes.

targets.observed: Processes deletes, generation requests, fast/simple/peek queues, existence checks and bounded ordinary generation attempts.
targets.caveats: Fast chunk operations and other queues have different semantics; cannot apply one fair scheduler indiscriminately.

targets.observed: Loads existing columns or generates new ones, handles staged passes, enqueues main-thread finalization and flags request disposal/requeue.
targets.caveats: Mixed load/generation inclusive duration; modifying disposal/index lifetime can duplicate requests or orphan work.

targets.observed: Selects a request eligible for stage bounds and neighborhood requirements, then PopulateChunk.
targets.caveats: CurrentIncompletePass, untilPass, neighbors and queue flags protect generation order; invasive scheduling is deferred pending profiling.

targets.observed: Executes registered generators for a pass.
targets.caveats: Third-party generator callbacks may rely on exact lifecycle; instrumentation must not mutate shared world data or infer thread safety.

targets.observed: Loads and deserializes existing chunk data.
targets.caveats: Combined disk/cache/deserialization duration is not raw disk latency; no changed database policy or asynchronous mutation.

targets.observed: Obtains suspend lock, pauses server, notifies player and mod/system save events, resumes server.
targets.caveats: This does not measure complete offthread persistence; log separately from full disk completion.

targets.observed: Serializes save/player/mapregion state. With saveLater=true copies loaded-chunk references and sets offthread flag.
targets.caveats: Mod save callbacks and save data correctness are authoritative. Existing stock save is already partly offthread.

targets.observed: When runOffThreadSaveNow=true, serializes dirty loaded/generating chunks and map chunks, updates claims, stores SaveGame, clears flag.
targets.caveats: Called often with no work; sample only actual saves. End-to-end save metric spans prep through this completion; shutdown synchronous path differs.

targets.observed: Serializes dirty loaded chunks using reusable thread-static FastMemoryStream.
targets.caveats: No extra forced GC or incremental save policy without measured need and crash/reload validation.

targets.observed: Processes queued block callbacks up to Config.MaxMainThreadBlockTicks with per-block catches.
targets.caveats: Not the same as all block entity listeners. Budget changes can delay fluids/growth/mod actions.

targets.observed: Scans player-near chunk cubes, deduplicates chunks in chunksToBeTicked, marks fresh and ticks chunk blocks.
targets.caveats: Already deduplicates overlapping player neighborhoods. Do not lower ranges or omit MarkFresh to obtain misleading performance.

targets.observed: Invokes public Handler Action<float>; optional ErrorHandler; updates LastUpdateMilliseconds.
targets.caveats: Cache bounded method/assembly labels; never retain handlers, world/player objects, or identify every block position in metric keys.

targets.observed: Invokes HandlerBare or Handler with world/position/dt, honoring ErrorHandler.
targets.caveats: Attribution must cover both handler shapes. Preserve exact callback delta and exception behavior.

targets.observed: Executes registered game/block listeners and delayed callbacks; Debug variant adds stock per-callback marks.
targets.caveats: GameTickListener hooks do not cover delayed direct Handler invocations; report coverage gaps rather than claiming every event is attributed.

targets.observed: Allocates temporary List<IPlayer> plus caller-owned ToArray result after state/range/predicate checks.
targets.caveats: Candidate temporary-list reuse only with reentrancy, exceptions, bounded retained capacity, identical order/predicate calls and fresh result ownership.
